title: Pokemon TCG Decidueye ex Perfect Order 012/088 Holofoil Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Decidueye ex 012/088 Double Rare Holo ME03: Perfect Order card is a highly sought-after collectible card in the Pokemon TCG world. With its Grass attribute, EX speciality, and stunning holofoil finish, this card features the character Decidueye ex illustrated by PLANETA Mochizuki. Manufactured by The Pokemon Company in the United States, this card is a valuable addition to any collector's deck. Its rarity and unique attributes make it a desirable item for fans of the Pokemon TCG.
